Q: NodeJS: localhost keeps loading for new project but is working fine for old project A:

At your solution number 4, you wrote:

ipconfig/release
ipconfig/renew
ipconfig /flushdns

“But powershell doesn't recognize it as an external or internal command”

I have a “Wi-Fi doesn’t have a valid IP configuration” problem, and attempted the three ipconfig commands above.
Well, I discovered the hard way that there has to be a space character separating the ipconfig command and the ‘/’ parameter. Should be:
ipconfig /release
ipconfig /renew
ipconfig /flushdns

I hope this helps.

Q: Can't log into localhost:8000/admin ... ERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED A:

Based on the limited info:

  1. Try to access 127.0.0.1:8000/admin instead of localhost:8000/admin.
  2. In django's settings set ALLOWED_HOSTS = ['*'] (NOTE: This is only for development).
  3. Check if something else is not already runnning on that port. You can use the following command on Mac lsof -Pn -i4 | grep -i "listen".
